name: ADE20K: Scene Parsing and Segmentation Benchmark
description: A comprehensive scene parsing and semantic segmentation benchmark dataset created by the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) at MIT. Contains 22,210 complex natural images densely annotated down to individual pixel-level segmentations across 365 scene categories and 150 semantic object/stuff classes, with additional object parts and hierarchical segmentations. Serves as the standard benchmark for semantic scene parsing and image synthesis evaluation.

publisher.name: MIT CSAIL (Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory)

license.notes: Dataset images originate from third-party sources (SUN/Places databases) and are strictly limited to non-commercial academic research and educational use. Annotations, segmentation masks, and development code are released by MIT CSAIL under the BSD 3-Clause License.
